title: Composition of transport on canonical stalks
statement: With [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions], for any original Cartesian square sq and any φ:U→V over T, t_V followed by r_φ equals t_U.

source.place: Tags 0F07 (restriction square and limit condition) and 09Z1 (higher direct image continuity)

proof.text: Apply target transition composition, including its inverse-image coefficient comparison. Uniqueness of the Cartesian lift proves that the composite of the pullback lifts is the direct lift. The equation φ.left followed by V.hom = U.hom identifies the coefficients. Applying the stalk functor gives the asserted composition equation.
